        # Input channel dimension
        in_channels = 3

            in_channels=in_channels,

        )

        # Average pooling
        self.avg_pool1 = nn.AvgPool2D(
            kernel_size=2,
            stride=2,
            padding=0
        )

        # Second Conv layer

            in_channels=in_channels // 3,
            out_channels=in_channels // 3,
            kernel_size=1,
            stride=1,
            padding=0,
            weight_initializer=nn_initializer.XavierUniform()
        )

        # Average pooling
        self.avg_pool2 = nn.AvgPool2D(
            kernel_size=2,
            stride=2,
            padding=0
        )

        # Third Conv layer
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2D(
            in_channels=in_channels // 3,
            out_channels=in_channels // 3,
            kernel_size=1,
            stride=1,
            padding=0,
            weight_initializer=nn_initializer.XavierUniform()
        )

        # Average pooling
        self.avg_pool3 = nn.AvgPool2D(
            kernel_size=2,
            stride=2,
            padding=0
        )

        # Concatenate the results
        self.concat = nn.Concat(dim=1)

        # Flatten
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()

        # First Linear layer
        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(
            in_features=in_channels // 3 * 3,
            out_features=128,
            weight_initializer=nn_initializer.XavierUniform()
        )

        # Second Linear layer
        self.linear2 = nn.Linear(
            in_features=128,
            out_features=10,
            weight_initializer=nn_initializer.XavierUniform()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # First Conv layer
        x = self.conv1(x)

        # Average pooling
        x = self.avg_pool1(x)

        # Second Conv layer
        x = self.conv2(x)

        return x
